Dockerfile

FROM --platform=${BUILDPLATFORM} node:24@sha256:8530f76a96d88820d288761f022e318970dda93d01536919fbc16076b7983e63 AS build

WORKDIR /opt/node_app

COPY . .

# do not ignore optional dependencies:
# Error: Cannot find module @rollup/rollup-linux-x64-gnu
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/yarn \
    npm_config_target_arch=${TARGETARCH} yarn --frozen-lockfile --network-timeout 600000

ARG NODE_ENV=production

RUN npm_config_target_arch=${TARGETARCH} yarn build:app:docker

FROM nginx:stable-alpine-slim@sha256:2c605dbeab79a6b2a63340474fe58119d0ef95bdc4b1f41df0aa689659b3d13b

COPY --from=build /opt/node_app/excalidraw-app/build /usr/share/nginx/html

HEALTHCHECK CMD wget -q -O /dev/null http://localhost || exit 1

Cixfile

FROM github:NixOS/nixpkgs/nixos-unstable AS pkgs

BUILDER build
  IMPORT ${pkgs.nodejs_24} ${pkgs.yarn} ${pkgs.coreutils} ${pkgs.findutils} ${pkgs.gnused} ${pkgs.bash} ${pkgs.cacert}
  COPY context/ .
  COPY build-app.sh build-app.sh
  FETCH bash build-app.sh

SERVICE excalidraw
  IMPORT ${pkgs.nginx}
  COPY ${build}/excalidraw-app/build /usr/share/nginx/html
  COPY ${pkgs.nginx}/conf/mime.types /etc/nginx/mime.types
  COPY nginx.conf /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
  START nginx -g 'daemon off;' -c /etc/nginx/nginx.conf -e stderr
  PORT http = 80
  RUNDIR /run/nginx
  READINESS http :80/ IN 30s

build-app.sh

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e

rm -rf node_modules excalidraw-app/build
unset NODE_ENV
yarn install --frozen-lockfile --network-timeout 600000
NODE_ENV=production yarn build:app:docker
for prefix in index CodeMirrorEditor; do
  old_path=$(find excalidraw-app/build/assets -maxdepth 1 -type f -name "$prefix-*.js" -print -quit)
  if [ -n "$old_path" ]; then
    old_name=${old_path##*/}
    new_name="$prefix.js"
    find excalidraw-app/build -type f \( -name '*.css' -o -name '*.html' -o -name '*.js' -o -name '*.json' -o -name '*.map' -o -name '*.txt' -o -name '*.webmanifest' -o -name '*.xml' \) -exec sed -i "s|$old_name|$new_name|g" {} +
    mv "$old_path" "excalidraw-app/build/assets/$new_name"
  fi
  old_path=$(find excalidraw-app/build/assets -maxdepth 1 -type f -name "$prefix-*.js.map" -print -quit)
  if [ -n "$old_path" ]; then
    old_name=${old_path##*/}
    new_name="$prefix.js.map"
    find excalidraw-app/build -type f \( -name '*.css' -o -name '*.html' -o -name '*.js' -o -name '*.json' -o -name '*.map' -o -name '*.txt' -o -name '*.webmanifest' -o -name '*.xml' \) -exec sed -i "s|$old_name|$new_name|g" {} +
    mv "$old_path" "excalidraw-app/build/assets/$new_name"
  fi
done
sed -i -E 's#<lastmod>[^<]*</lastmod>#<lastmod>1970-01-01</lastmod>#g' excalidraw-app/build/sitemap.xml
rm -f excalidraw-app/build/sw.js.map
rm -rf node_modules
check.sh 
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

mode=${1:?usage: ./check.sh docker|cix}
root=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd)
cix=${CIX:-"$root/../../../../target/debug/cix"}
name=migrate-r5-excalidraw
container=
unit=

cleanup() {
  [[ -z $unit ]] || sudo -n systemctl stop "$unit" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  [[ -z $container ]] || docker rm -f "$container" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT

probe() {
  for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
    if curl --fail --silent --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:18090/ | grep -q 'Excalidraw Whiteboard'; then
      return 0
    fi
    sleep 1
  done
  return 1
}

[[ -d $root/context ]] || { echo 'context/ missing — run ../../fetch.sh excalidraw first' >&2; exit 1; }
cd "$root"
case $mode in
  docker)
    image=$(timeout 1200 docker build --quiet --file Dockerfile --tag "$name" context)
    printf 'docker image %s\n' "$image"
    container=$(timeout 30 docker run --detach --rm --publish 127.0.0.1:18090:80 "$name")
    probe
    printf 'PASS docker\n'
    ;;
  cix)
    item=$(timeout 1200 "$cix" build .#excalidraw)
    printf 'cix item %s\n' "$item"
    unit=$(timeout 30 sudo -n "$cix" run --detach "$item" | tail -n1)
    printf 'cix unit %s\n' "$unit"
    probe
    printf 'PASS cix\n'
    ;;
  *) echo 'usage: ./check.sh docker|cix' >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

nginx.conf

pid /run/nginx/nginx.pid;

events {}

http {
  include /etc/nginx/mime.types;
  default_type application/octet-stream;
  access_log /run/nginx/access.log;
  error_log /run/nginx/error.log warn;
  sendfile on;
  client_body_temp_path /run/nginx/client_body;
  proxy_temp_path /run/nginx/proxy;
  fastcgi_temp_path /run/nginx/fastcgi;
  uwsgi_temp_path /run/nginx/uwsgi;
  scgi_temp_path /run/nginx/scgi;

  server {
    listen 80;
    root /usr/share/nginx/html;
    index index.html;
  }
}
